criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
NewCodecRegistry returns a non-nil, initialized registry, and RegisterCodec stores codecs keyed by a lowercased (case-insensitive) format name returning nil error.
Encoder/Decoder resolve case-insensitively from registered codecs first, then fall back to built-in codecs for yaml/yml, json, toml, and dotenv/env; the built-in fallback is present and not omitted.
criteria.contract_ref: Codec registry (encoding.go) / Known pitfalls: built-in codec fallback

criteria.text: When no codec matches, Encoder/Decoder return a non-nil error AND a nil encoder/decoder interface value (not a zero-value non-nil codec).
WithEncoderRegistry/WithDecoderRegistry/WithCodecRegistry install the given registry but treat a nil argument as a no-op rather than overwriting an existing valid registry with nil.
ConfigFileNotFoundError unwraps TO FileNotFoundFromSearchError (not the reverse) and delegates its message to that unwrapped error, so errors.As chains succeed.
criteria.contract_ref: Known pitfalls: Unwrap direction / Error types

criteria.text: exists(fs, path) returns false,nil for not-exist, false,err for other stat errors, and treats directories as non-existent config files (only true for existing non-directory entries).
The combined finder skips nil finders, continues past finders that error (does not short-circuit), concatenates all successful results, and aggregates/joins errors rather than dropping them.
criteria.contract_ref: Known pitfalls: Combined finder must not short-circuit
